PORT.description: Nginx HTTP port for the hexo service (Railway routes public domain here). Fixed at 80.

TZ.description: Container timezone for all services (IANA name, e.g. America/New_York).

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Login name for the hexo-admin web editor at /admin/.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated password for the hexo-admin editor (read it from the hexo service's Variables tab after deploy).

ARTALK_SITE_NAME.description: Site name used by the Artalk comment system.

ARTALK_SITE_URL.description: Public URL of the Artalk service. Auto-derived from comments service's public domain.

ARTALK_DB_TYPE.description: Comment database: sqlite (file on the persistent volume) or pgsql/mysql/mssql (set DATABASE_URL too).

ARTALK_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email of the first comment moderator (login at /comment/admin/ on the comments service domain).

ARTALK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated password for the Artalk moderator account.

ARTALK_APP_KEY.description: JWT signing key for Artalk (must be stable across restarts). Auto-generated on deploy.

ARTALK_TRUSTED_DOMAINS.description: Extra origins allowed to call the comment API (space-separated). Auto-includes hexo's domain for CORS.

ARTALK_LOCALE.description: UI language (e.g. en, zh-CN, ja, fr, ko, ru, tr).

MINIO_ROOT_USER.description: S3 root username for the MinIO object store.

MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Auto-generated S3 root password for MinIO (read from storage service's Variables tab after deploy).
